— Google Ads

Meet demand. Make every click accountable.

Google Ads can put your business in front of people looking for a solution. I help connect campaign structure, search intent, landing pages, and measurement so the account supports a defined business goal.

Discuss google ads

A connected approach to google ads

An advertising account is only one part of the customer journey. A search term may be relevant while the destination page is confusing; a campaign may generate inquiries while the sales team finds them unsuitable. My approach considers the whole path, from the words a customer uses to the action your business can follow up. Campaign selection follows that understanding, rather than starting with every available Google Ads feature.

When this work can help

  • Budget is being spent without a reliable view of qualified leads or sales.
  • Search queries, ads, and landing pages do not tell the same story.
  • An existing account has become difficult to review or improve.

How I approach the work

I review the offer, audience, account history, conversion definitions, and available budget. That leads to a campaign plan with a clear scope, exclusions, landing-page needs, and a measurement checklist. Where the account already exists, I inspect it before recommending a rebuild: preserving useful history can be more valuable than starting again.

Core activities & deliverables

Campaign planning

Select appropriate campaign types, group related intent, define geography only when supplied, and establish budget controls. Check policy restrictions and the practical limits of the offer.

Ads and destinations

Develop clear messaging and relevant assets, review keyword matching and negative keywords, and connect each campaign to a suitable destination. Coordinate landing-page improvements where agreed.

Ongoing decisions

Review search terms, spend, conversion quality, and changes in demand. Test specific hypotheses and record changes so reporting can distinguish a useful result from normal fluctuation.

Who this is for

Google Ads can suit a service business with existing demand, an e-commerce operation with a reliable product feed, or an established company seeking a structured account review. A clear offer, a workable landing page, and capacity to respond to inquiries are important prerequisites. Advertising budget is separate from consulting or management fees and should be agreed with realistic expectations.

What to consider before starting

No campaign can guarantee leads, revenue, or return on ad spend. Auction costs, competition, offer strength, seasonality, consent, and tracking restrictions affect results. Automated campaign types still need accurate inputs and review. Platform-reported conversions are useful signals, but do not automatically prove that advertising caused every reported sale.

How we assess progress

I prefer a small number of meaningful conversions over a long list of low-value clicks. Where feasible, lead quality and downstream outcomes should inform decisions alongside cost per conversion. Reporting explains budget use, campaign changes, and the next test, with attribution limits made explicit.

Questions about google ads

Should I start with Search or Performance Max?+

The choice depends on your goals, available creative, conversion data, and whether you sell products. Search can provide a focused starting point for explicit demand; Performance Max requires suitable inputs and close review.

Is ad spend included?+

Platform spend and professional work are separate costs. Scope, access, and budget expectations should be agreed before campaigns launch.
